topic: Retrieving facility addresses using MAC addresses
summary_markdown:
The conversation involved a request to retrieve physical facility addresses based on a provided list of MAC addresses. The user provided a long list of MAC addresses and requested the execution of a PostgreSQL query.

The proposed SQL query was:
```sql
select f.id, address1, address2, f.region, b.region, b.locality, b.street_address
from facility f
    join (
        select *
        from box
        where upper(mac_address) in ('MAC1','MAC2', ...)
    ) b on f.id = b.facility_id;
```
After running the query, it was determined that no addresses were found for any of the provided MAC addresses.
decisions: The facility address lookup using the list of MAC addresses was attempted.
